result.instructions: Tools for Parsley, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our recipes contain peanuts or tree nuts?"; "Show the nutrition facts and ingredient list for the lemon chicken."; "What events are on the calendar next week and which menu does each use?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Parsley data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run parsley_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run parsley_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run parsley_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. parsley_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: parsley_list_menu_items
tools.title: List menu items
tools.description: List the recipes, sub-recipes and ingredients in the Parsley account that can be used on events: id, name, item number, price, tags, active flag, chef and last-modified time. Use the ids with parsley_get_menu_item for nutrition, allergens and ingredients, and on events. The API returns the whole list at once; search/limit/offset slice it here. GET /menu_items.

search.description: Only menu items whose name contains this text (case-insensitive).

tag.description: Only items carrying this tag (exact, case-insensitive).

offset.description: Skip this many results (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: parsley_get_menu_item
tools.title: Get menu item (nutrition, allergens, ingredients)
tools.description: One menu item in full: names, description, price, cost, shelf life, serving size, nutrition facts (nutrients), the allergen flags and allergen text, dietary characteristics (meat, pork, corn, poultry) and the ingredient list. The photo link is returned without its access token. GET /menu_items/{id}.

tools.name: parsley_list_menus
tools.title: List menus
tools.description: List the menus (menu plans) in the account: id, name and last-modified time. Use the id with parsley_get_menu or when creating an event. GET /menus.

search.description: Only menus whose name contains this text (case-insensitive).

offset.description: Skip this many results (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: parsley_get_menu
tools.title: Get menu
tools.description: One menu with its sections and the menu items in each section, and its serving stations. GET /menus/{id}.

tools.name: parsley_list_ingredients
tools.title: List ingredients
tools.description: List the ingredients that can be used in recipes: id, parent id, name, label name, item number, supported units, and whether a recipe uses it. The API returns the whole list at once; search/limit/offset slice it here. GET /ingredients.

search.description: Only ingredients whose name contains this text (case-insensitive).

used_by_recipe.description: true: only ingredients used by a recipe; false: only unused ones.

offset.description: Skip this many results (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: parsley_get_ingredient
tools.title: Get ingredient (costing and suppliers)
tools.description: One ingredient in full: unit conversions, supported units, tags, the supply options (supplier, SKU, pack size, cost) used for costing and the preparations with yield. Parsley limits this call to 1 request every 3 seconds, so fetch ingredients one at a time. GET /ingredients/{id}.

tools.name: parsley_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List events (a workday, shift, service or catering event) that fall in a date window: id, name, type (standard, cafe-hot-bar, sale, forecast), date, start and end time, menu id. A bare date means the whole day in the account timezone. GET /events.

start.description: Window start (inclusive): yyyy-mm-dd or an ISO 8601 date-time. Without a timezone the account timezone applies.

end.description: Window end (inclusive): yyyy-mm-dd (to the end of that day) or an ISO 8601 date-time.

search.description: Only events whose name contains this text (case-insensitive).

offset.description: Skip this many results (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: parsley_get_event
tools.title: Get event
tools.description: One event with its metadata and all line items (menu item, amount, unit, station, section). GET /events/{id}.

tools.name: parsley_list_serving_stations
tools.title: List serving stations
tools.description: List the serving stations (id, name) that menu items and event line items can be assigned to. GET /tags/serving_stations.

offset.description: Skip this many results (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: parsley_list_chef_tags
tools.title: List chef tags
tools.description: List the chef tags (id, name) that recipes are attributed to. Only meaningful for accounts with Chef IDs enabled. GET /tags/chefs.

offset.description: Skip this many results (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: parsley_list_chef_users
tools.title: List chef users
tools.description: List the chef users of the account: id, email, join date, active flag, permission level and the chef tag they are tied to. Only meaningful for accounts with Chef IDs enabled. GET /users/chefs.

search.description: Only chef users (matched on email or chef name) whose name contains this text (case-insensitive).

offset.description: Skip this many results (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: parsley_create_event
tools.title: Create event
tools.description: WRITE: create an event (a workday, shift, service or catering event) in Parsley with its menu items. This changes the account's production plan and is NOT idempotent: calling it twice creates two events. Returns the new event id. Use parsley_list_events first to avoid duplicates. POST /events.

type.description: Event type: standard, cafe-hot-bar, sale or forecast.

date.description: The day of the event, yyyy-mm-dd.

menu_id.description: Parsley menu id the event uses (from parsley_list_menus).

menu_item.description: Parsley menu item id (from parsley_list_menu_items). Give this OR item_id.

item_id.description: The menu item's own item number (itemNumber). Give this OR menu_item.

uom.description: Unit of measure as Parsley expects it: kg, lb, gr, oz, ml, cup, qt, pt, tsp, Tbsp, fl oz, liter, gal, ea, ea2 (Parsley's own examples also use 'portions').

line_items.description: The menu items and amounts to produce or sell (may be empty).

tools.name: parsley_update_event_covers
tools.title: Update event covers
tools.description: WRITE: set the forecast and/or actual number of covers (guests served) on an event. Only the fields you pass change. actual_covers works only on cafe/hot bar events. Setting the same values again has no further effect. PATCH /events/{id}.

actual_covers.description: Real number of covers (cafe/hot bar events only).

tools.name: parsley_record_event_sales
tools.title: Record event sales
tools.description: WRITE: push sold quantities per menu item to a cafe/hot bar event, which feeds Parsley's cost and usage reports. Other event types are refused by Parsley, as is a menu item with no made quantity on the event. Sending the same quantities again overwrites rather than adds. PUT /events/{id}/sales.

event_id.description: Parsley event id of a cafe/hot bar event.

menu_item.description: Parsley menu item id (from parsley_list_menu_items). Give this OR item_id.

item_id.description: The menu item's own item number (itemNumber). Give this OR menu_item.

uom.description: Unit of measure as Parsley expects it: kg, lb, gr, oz, ml, cup, qt, pt, tsp, Tbsp, fl oz, liter, gal, ea, ea2 (Parsley's own examples also use 'portions').

tools.name: parsley_record_waste_leftover
tools.title: Record waste and leftover
tools.description: WRITE: push waste and/or leftover quantities per menu item to a cafe/hot bar event. If no sold quantity exists, Parsley derives it as made minus waste minus leftover. Parsley refuses amounts above what was made minus sold. Sending the same quantities again overwrites rather than adds. PUT /events/{id}/waste_leftover.

event_id.description: Parsley event id of a cafe/hot bar event.

waste_uom.description: Unit of measure as Parsley expects it: kg, lb, gr, oz, ml, cup, qt, pt, tsp, Tbsp, fl oz, liter, gal, ea, ea2 (Parsley's own examples also use 'portions').

leftover_uom.description: Unit of measure as Parsley expects it: kg, lb, gr, oz, ml, cup, qt, pt, tsp, Tbsp, fl oz, liter, gal, ea, ea2 (Parsley's own examples also use 'portions').
